enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Body still. Breathing regularly.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Rub face. Wipe with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, preparing a cold drink for the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, eggs, milk. Open cupboard. Take out plate, bowl, glass, utensils. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread. Spread butter. Prepare cold drink: pour milk into glass, add ice cubes, pour water. Sit at table. Eat breakfast and drink cold drink. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing study materials, laptop and water bottle for university
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open backpack. Place laptop in backpack. Place charger in backpack. Place notebooks in backpack. Place textbooks in backpack. Place pencil case in backpack. Zip backpack. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water bottle. Fill water bottle from tap. Close water bottle. Place water bottle in backpack side pocket. Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Place phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Place keys in pocket. Put on shoes. Stand up. Walk to door. Open door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to Monash University
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Stand up. Exit train. Walk to campus. Enter campus. Walk to lecture hall.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Education lectures and tutorials on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Sit at desk. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Open notebook. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to answer. Take more notes. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Type notes. Close laptop. Pack up. Stand up. Walk to next tutorial room. Enter room. Sit at desk. Participate in group discussion. Speak. Listen to group members. Write on whiteboard. Return to seat. Pack up. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch at the campus food court
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to food court. Join queue. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Carry tray to bin. Scrape food into bin. Place tray on stack. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the university library, working on assignments and readings
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to library. Enter library. Find empty desk. Sit down. Open backpack. Take out laptop. Turn on laptop. Connect to Wi-Fi. Open assignment file. Read instructions. Open textbook. Read chapter. Take notes. Type notes. Open browser. Search for references. Read article. Copy citation. Paste into document. Write paragraph. Save document. Check time. Stand up. Walk to bookshelf. Pick up book. Return to desk. Read book. Take more notes. Close book. Pack up. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from university by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Stand up. Exit train. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Open cupboard. Take out cookware and utensils. Prepare ingredients: wash and chop vegetables, cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Add meat and vegetables. Stir-fry. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Cook rice in rice cooker. Serve rice and stir-fry onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and equipment, then taking a cool shower to escape the heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen sink. Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply dish soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Turn off tap. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower temperature. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to bedroom. Put on clean clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying online course materials and completing assignment work on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open online course platform. Watch video lecture, taking notes. Open assignment file. Read instructions. Type response. Research references and incorporate citations. Write paragraph. Save document. Stand up and stretch, then sit down. Continue writing. Finish assignment. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, checking the phone and setting an alarm
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like posts. Comment on post. Close app. Open messaging app. Read messages. Reply to message. Close app. Open clock app. Set alarm for 6:30 AM. Turn off phone. Place phone on bedside table. Turn off bedroom light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Body still. Breathing regularly.
